function.description: This tool belongs to the vehicle control system, which allows users to control various aspects of the car such as engine, doors, climate control, lights, and more. temperature.description: The temperature to set in degree. Default to be celsius. This is a float type value.

fanSpeed.description: The fan speed to set from 0 to 100. Default is 50.

currentTemperature.description: The current temperature set in degree Celsius.
